title: I recreated a few of obscure games I remember playing growing up
author: That1guy4226
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/cr95inqsdezh1.png

So this is a collection of games that I remember collecting and playing when I was young. I have changed the names of all of them for legal reasons and credited the original creator and the publisher. I wanted to play them again but didn't like the current online options that I could find. 

I have added local multiplayer as well as bot with some having multiple difficulty levels as well as some games have advanced rule sets to try out.   
If you find any issues or have ideas to improve anything let me know.   


[https://that1guy8691.itch.io/tabletopcollection](https://that1guy8691.itch.io/tabletopcollection)
